title: Packing Days for Multi-Unit Returns
content:
Returns with several units take longer to pack. A courtesy extension of a Returns & Exchanges return-by date adds packing days by the units authorized on the return — the units of every line placed on the authorization, added together.

| Units authorized on the return | Packing days added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 3 days |
| 2 or 3 | 2 days |
| 1 | None |

## Boundaries

| Units | Packing days |
|---|---|
| 1 | None |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 2 |
| 4 | 3 |

Example (hypothetical): an authorization with 2 units of one line and 1 unit of another holds 3 units and adds 2 packing days.
